title: tdh.util.ad~
description: `tdh.util.ad~` generates a three-stage envelope at both data and signal rates, suitable for controlling values such as oscillator amplitude or MIDI pitch. A gate value above 0 ramps from 0 to the sustain level over the attack time, and a subsequent 0 ramps back to 0 over the decay time; alternatively, a bang triggers a fixed-duration envelope.
